about: Behaviour checks for the main-chat dispatch decision (#4829, docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Dispatch): what the assistant does with one user message. Synthetic cases only. tasks: what task_plan should carry (empty: no task). start: how those tasks start per the hub's own rule (auto: every task read-only or user-requested; card: something waits for Start; none: no tasks). asks_user: an ask_user to the owner instead of a guess. direct_tools_any: instant-tier tool prefixes, any of which passes.
